title: PC3 menus can get cut off or drawn under standard windows because they aren't drawn as a separate window
line: The context menu of a text field on the desktop, like the file rename field, now appears above other windows instead of underneath them.
explanation: The right-click menu of text fields (qqc2-desktop-style's shared TextFieldContextMenu, used by the desktop's rename field and by every QQC2 app with the Plasma style) was an in-scene popup, drawn inside the text field's own window. On the desktop that window sits below every app window, so the menu was covered by them, and in a small app window it was squeezed inside the window with a scrollbar. The menu now opens as a window popup from a 1x1 point at the click or text cursor (on Wayland a window menu is placed against its whole parent item). In a QQuickWidget (System Settings and its KCMs) it stays in-scene: a new WindowUtils.isEmbedded() helper asks Qt's public QQuickRenderControl::renderWindowFor() whether the window is rendered into another one, because QQuickWidget forwards mouse events without their device and window popups there lose every other right-click.

commits.message:
TextFieldContextMenu: Open the menu as its own window

The text menu was drawn inside the field's window, so it was cut off or
covered by other windows. It now opens as a window popup at the click,
except in a QQuickWidget, where Qt's window popups miss the next click.

BUG: 517982

media.caption: Desktop rename field (F2) right-clicked with Konsole next to the icon: the text menu is drawn underneath Konsole
Same steps with the fix: the text menu opens at the pointer above Konsole
Discover in a short window, search field right-clicked: the menu is squeezed inside the window with a scrollbar and covers the field
Same with the fix: the menu opens at the pointer as its own window and extends below Discover's window
